decisions.reason: The charting bundle extends the firm's core map.apps platform, and four releases in four weeks show active learning and iteration on knowledge the firm already holds.
This small search bundle builds directly on existing map.apps search capabilities, so it costs little to maintain and can be absorbed into the platform even though it gets little visibility.

This experimental Vue-based mobile component was announced once as a new approach and may be folded into other offerings, but it still draws on the firm's web-mapping expertise and gives it useful mobile learning.
As the flagship platform with several models, it embodies the firm's accumulated GIS engineering knowledge and is the base on which the other bundles depend.
Mobile field data capture fits the firm's integrated enterprise geospatial strategy and its close cooperation with platform providers, and it has a page of its own.
The search extension is closely tied to the firm's existing web map app know-how and is presented on its own page, so the firm can readily interpret customer feedback and improve it.
